plugins.name: whatsapp
plugins.description: Read, triage and reply to WhatsApp from a dedicated Claude Code session, with a chat allowlist and a hard block on bypass-permissions mode.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Send email with local attachments from any terminal through the Gmail API: your own OAuth client, every send and draft behind your Touch ID.

metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for messaging channels, one per channel. Gmail: send with attachments, every send behind Touch ID. WhatsApp: allowlisted chats, a dedicated session, and a hard block on bypass mode.
